intent: Add the missing opt-in Arena live-measurement entrypoint. It constructs Taskpack, LiveWorkerPool, the exact public-specialty roster, OrchestrationGenome, and ArenaRunner as one fail-closed path; stages every artifact outside the repository; requires complete unique live receipts for every roster-seat/task pair; requires each raw provider-returned model identity to be a non-empty string exactly equal to the requested roster seat without coercion or normalization; requires prompt and completion token counts to be genuine non-negative integers whose positive sum is the recorded cost; rejects completion-token counts above the configured per-call cap; makes RecordedReplayPool revalidate the same provider identity, token-accounting, cap, and uniqueness invariants instead of coercing receipt values; verifies best_single_full_budget, exact best_single_parity_budget, the shared parity ledger, and seeded significance against both baselines before publishing any candidate status; preserves the runner result only as an evidence-level control_outcome while publishing the authority-bearing closeout_state as the canonical non-promotable blocked_with_evidence state and claim_boundary as measurement_candidate_only; leaves the Council-hashed promotion_claim unchanged and publishes sibling promotion_claim_authority metadata as evidence_only with promotion_authorized=false; binds every non-self output byte-for-byte in a stable sha256 manifest and revalidates it before atomic publication; and labels every result measurement-candidate-only with capability_claim=false and promotion_authorized=false. No provider call, live benchmark result, capability claim, ACTIVE_TRACK edit, generated projection edit, or production-routing weight is admitted.

commit.message: fix(arena): enforce live evidence authority boundary [impact-checked]

interface_mismatches: LiveWorkerPool names dharma_swarm.coordination.arena.measure as its only explicit constructor, but that module does not exist on the exact base, leaving DHARMA_ARENA_LIVE as a refusing fixture flag rather than a controlled live-measurement route.

ArenaRunner already runs full-budget, exact-parity, and seeded-significance controls, but no live entrypoint proves a live pool used that same runner and published only after receipt and control validation.

Existing MAP-Elites and cold-start-corpus consumers treat closeout_state=positive_lift_candidate as sufficient promotion eligibility and do not consult promotion_authorized, so a live wrapper must separate the runner's evidence-level control_outcome from its non-promotable published closeout_state.
honest_blockers: This packet builds and tests the opt-in route with an injected no-network transport; it performs no provider call, produces no real benchmark evidence, and supports no capability claim.

The current AgentOps packet-scope CI returns NOT_REQUIRED because Arena paths and the packet path are outside its risk trigger; isolated preflight/closeout is the only packet enforcement, and broadening that sibling-owned trigger is outside this packet.

The shared worktree Git admin has active .git/info/exclude entries, so packet evidence is intentionally produced only in an isolated clone without hidden local excludes; no shared-worktree evaluator result is claimed.

The Arena track's declared owned_surfaces do not enumerate tests/test_arena_parity_controls.py, and the current AgentOps validator does not independently enforce allowed_files as a subset of track custody. This packet does not amend sibling-owned ACTIVE_TRACK governance; the test change therefore remains subject to the packet's exact-head human approval gate.
ACTIVE_TRACK blocker state and generated projections stay unchanged. A separate governance owner must evaluate merged code plus real evidence before marking next-item 2 done or closing the track.
Any main movement before merge invalidates the packet base, collision record, digest, and preflight binding.
